purpose: Teach: ソヴィエト/マオリ/秦/劉/宋/萬/鵐/カキ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧ソヴィエト圏の市場開拓を慎重に進めろ
lines.en: We need to approach the former Soviet markets with careful deliberation.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear enunciation on key market terms. Steady pace—this is a directive, not a suggestion. Slight weight on 'careful.' No room for ambiguity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ニュージーランドのマオリ文化を尊重した商品展開をします
lines.en: Understood. We'll develop our product line with respect for New Zealand Māori culture.
lines.style: Crisp affirmation. Lean forward slightly on the commitment. Professional tone—acknowledging the instruction and restating it to confirm alignment. Even pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中国市場では古代秦の故事を引用するな
lines.en: And in the Chinese market, do not invoke classical Qin dynasty narratives.
lines.style: Sharp, direct prohibition. Slight hardening on 'do not'—emphasis without raising volume. Pause before the reason. This is a constraint, not a guideline.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。漢の劉邦の故事は社内向けに留めます
lines.en: Understood. References to Han dynasty Liu Bang will be reserved for internal communication only.
lines.style: Confirmation with precision. Slightly faster pace—he's demonstrating he grasps the boundary. Respect in the tone; he's narrowing the scope correctly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、宋朝の文化遺産に学ぶ姿勢を持て
lines.en: The company should cultivate a posture of learning from Song dynasty cultural heritage.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful directive. Open vowels on 'Song'—let the period breathe. Moderate pace. This is aspirational, not punitive. Slight warmth underlying the formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧字「萬」、つまり万の入った社名はそのまま残します
lines.en: Understood. The company name will retain the traditional character for 'ten thousand' as is.
lines.style: Precise confirmation with technical detail. Slight emphasis on 'retain'—he understands this is preservation, not change. Methodical, respectful tone. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、希少鳥類の鵐、つまり鵐保護に賛同しろ
lines.en: The company should endorse protection efforts for the rare yamadori species.
lines.style: Formal commitment phrased as principle. Slight lift on the rare-bird name—demonstrate he's serious about the distinction. Deliberate pace. This is about values alignment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。牡蠣、つまりカキ事業の品質管理を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We will strengthen quality control across our oyster operations.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly broader scope than previous responses—he's integrating the instruction into operational reality. Calm, professional close. Light finishing weight on 'strengthen.'
